known_deltas: Threshold audit (step 0.3): v3.0 literals captured in config.legacy_verification with IDENTICAL defaults. No conflicts with agent thresholds (0.85/0.75/0.60).
Contract refinements: log_event trace_id; metrics local/network timing; Retry-After -> max(backoff, header); llm_call.attempts; latency_ms = all attempts incl. sleeps.

LLM inventory (0.4): all LLM calls via DeepSeekClient; requests-direct only in image_gen (Flux, not LLM). _call_json failure channel preserved: {raw_response, parse_error} + extractor rule-fallback + log event.

Wikidata quirks (verified live 2026-10-14): API errors = HTTP 200 + {"error":{code,info}} (e.g. no-such-entity); search hit has no aliases; redirects field only on merged fetch (parser supports list[{from,to}] AND dict).

Pleiades reachability (1.2 stop-point #2): UNRESOLVED ENVIRONMENTALLY - TCP connect to 3.14.113.245 succeeds but no bytes/timeout x3 (curl + requests); firecrawl MCP returns systemic errors; web search empty. Mitigation: defensive .get()-parser against documented schema + tests/test_network_live.py::test_pleiades_live_schema (marker network; skips if unreachable). Curator can verify live when network allows.

Trismegistos (1.2 stop-point #1): no public API. Facts: SSL cert chain incomplete (verify fails: unable to get local issuer); verify=False -> HTTP 403 anti-bot on all paths (/api/, /dataservices/, /tm/...). DECISION (proposed, awaiting curator confirmation): option (a) stub adapter TrismegistosClient (no network, reason=no_public_api) + option (v) dataset integration deferred to Phase 2 backlog.

Fragment metric (1.2 stop-point #3, proposed definition): completeness_score = filled/5 among (intent, domain, entities, semantic_roles, evidence); is_fragment = detect_lacunae(text) OR completeness < FRAGMENT_THRESHOLD(0.5). Examples for curator verification (in 1.2 report): full atom -> 1.0/False; intent+domain only -> 0.4/True; [...]-marker with full fields -> 1.0/True.

source_unavailable placement (curator 1.2 note #3): lives on client-level results (SearchResult/EntityFetchResult/LinkResult/PlaceFetchResult) and propagates to Entity.source_unavailable when atom-level linking hits an outage; not_found/absence expressed via reason (missing, no-such-entity, offline_miss, ...) - Verification 1.3 must not penalize outages (neutral) and distinguish them from contradictions.
Redirect mapping is PERMANENT (no TTL) + separate redirect cache metrics namespace; cache_hit_rate counts only main lookups (search/entity). Documented in AGENTS.md.
Config validation: EntityLinkingConfig raises ConfigError when enabled=True without contact_email (fail-fast at import; env AEON_CONTACT_EMAIL required).
backlog: LLM retry jitter (+/-20%) - curator 0.4 note #2; apply at 1.4+ when concurrent atoms grow.
Trismegistos data integration via datasets (no public API) - deferred after 1.2 stop-point.

Phase 3: .aeon v2 (verification trace, entity links, hypotheses; v1 read compat), CLI analyze/link/fragments, web endpoints, README v4 + docs/ARCHITECTURE.md
